description: Canonical research-discovery registry for game years 600-1200, built from docs/research/y600/*_600_1200.md by tools/research/build_registry_1200.py. One entry per discovery; rows listed in more than one line are merged into one canonical entry and recorded under aliases. Continues docs/research/registry.json (0-600).

fields.id: catalog id (status catalog, in main scripts/*.gd), era-branch id (status era), or assigned slug (status new). No id repeats a 0-600 registry id; see redates.
fields.target_year/band_low/band_high: game year target and acceptable band from the source table
fields.shared_with: other lines the discovery touches: (shared: X) notes, (culture) markers, and lines of merged aliases
fields.key_threshold: row is bold (a key threshold) in its source table
fields.aliases: duplicate listings of the same practice in other lines, merged into this entry
